name: The Coast Isn't Clear
summary: Shipwrecked sailors struggle to reach Westfall's western shore as murlocs close in. Captain Grayson calls on you to clear the beaches so survivors can land safely.

sections.title: A Graveyard of Ships
sections.body: Reefs, squalls, and jagged rocks drive ships onto Westfall's shoals. Survivors cling to wreckage and crawl onto the sand, hoping help will come. They find murloc tribes along the shore instead, and the murlocs show no mercy to castaways.

sections.title: The Ghostly Lookout
sections.body: Captain Grayson watches from a lonely outcropping southwest of the mainland. Though dead, he remains bound to the lighthouse and to his duty toward passing ships and lost sailors. Coastrunners hold the northern shore. Farther south, Tidehunters, Warriors, and Oracles gather.

faq.answer: Captain Grayson is the spectral sea captain who haunts the Westfall Lighthouse. He still feels bound to protect sailors in dangerous waters and those who survive a wreck.

faq.q: Why does Grayson want the murlocs cleared from the coast?
faq.answer: Grayson wants the murlocs cleared because shipwrecked sailors often wash ashore along Westfall. Murlocs swarm the beaches from north to south and kill survivors who reach land.

faq.q: Where are these different murlocs located?
faq.answer: Murloc Coastrunners generally live along Westfall's northern coast. Murloc Warriors, Oracles, and Tidehunters gather in settlements and camps on the southern beaches.

faq.q: Is Captain Grayson hostile to the Alliance or Horde?
faq.answer: Captain Grayson is neutral. His duty to sailors crosses political lines, and he asks any capable traveler to make the coast safer.

faq.q: Does this quest require relighting the lighthouse first?
aliases: do i need keeper of the flame first
faq.answer: No. Captain Grayson asks you to clear the coast whether or not you have helped relight the Westfall Lighthouse.

faq.q: Are the murlocs working for the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: No. The murlocs act on their own and attack anyone entering their shoreline hunting grounds. The Defias Brotherhood operates nearby, in the Moonbrook region and southern coves.

angles.text: With the Stormwind army absent from Westfall, the People's Militia struggles to protect inland farms. Allies such as Captain Grayson help defend the coast.
As a human, you know merchant vessels and fishermen have long sailed Westfall's waters. The murloc-held shore is a bitter sign of the kingdom's lost frontiers.
